name: k-slide
title_zh: 韩英混排商务件翻成零韩语读者能核的英文版
tagline_zh: 表格、数字、术语、不确定语气、承诺程度全保留。韩语零基础同事拿到就能追着数字问，不用再猜原文到底说了算不算数。
tagline_en: Keeps tables, numbers, terms, hedging, and commitment intact. Zero-Korean colleagues can audit figures.
desc_en: Translate Korean or mixed Korean-English business artifacts into evidence-backed English comprehension for zero-Korean readers, preserving visual structure, tables, numbers, terminology, uncertainty, and commitment level.
why_zh: 不是翻译，是证据搬运。视觉结构原样保留，每个数字和每个“可能”都有出处，读者能逐格核对原文。
why_en: Not translation—evidence transfer. Visual layout survives, every number and hedge traces to the source, so readers audit the.
limit_zh: 只处理韩语或韩英混排的商务文档；不译纯英文、不译口语/聊天体。输出是英文理解稿，不是出版级译文，文学性。
limit_en: Only Korean or mixed Korean-English business docs. No pure English, no chat/colloquial text. Output is an English comprehension draft—not.
title_en: Korean-English business docs → verifiable English for.
